tokens.name: tg-bg
tokens.usage: Page background, set on body. The ground that tg-fg and tg-secondary are measured against.

tokens.name: tg-fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on tg-bg and tg-surface. Also the focus-ring colour and the drawn tg-rule in its data-on state.

tokens.name: tg-surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel fill: project-card, LiveFrame, the concierge panel. Ground for tg-fg and tg-secondary.

tokens.name: tg-border
tokens.usage: The resting hairline on every card, row, input and divider. 1px, never a shadow.

tokens.name: tg-border-strong
tokens.usage: The hairline on hover and focus, and the transient state of tg-rule.

tokens.name: tg-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy and timestamps on tg-bg and tg-surface. 4.91:1 and 4.50:1 in light; 4.93:1 and 4.51:1 in dark.

tokens.name: tg-cta-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. It inverts in dark mode, so the primary CTA is the brightest element on a dark page. No accent ever fills a button.

tokens.name: tg-cta-fg
tokens.usage: Label on tg-cta-bg. 17.9:1 light, 18.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: tg-cta-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover. Carries tg-cta-fg at 14.9:1 light, 15.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: tg-ink
tokens.usage: The brand black. Resolves tg-fg and tg-cta-bg in light mode, and is the literal fill of the home ink band in both themes.

tokens.name: tg-canvas
tokens.usage: The brand white. Resolves tg-bg in light mode.

tokens.name: tg-surface-card
tokens.usage: Light-mode card fill. Resolves tg-surface.

tokens.name: tg-hairline
tokens.usage: Light-mode hairline. Resolves tg-border, and is the connector stroke in the brand mark on a light surface.

tokens.name: tg-muted
tokens.usage: Light-mode secondary text. 4.91:1 on tg-canvas, 4.50:1 on tg-surface-card. The lightest step that clears AA on both.

tokens.name: tg-muted-soft
tokens.usage: NON-TEXT ONLY, retired as a text colour. Valid for mid-dot separators and the concierge thinking indicator.

tokens.name: tg-muted-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary text on every dark ground. 4.93:1 on tg-bg-dark, 4.90:1 on tg-ink, 4.51:1 on the dark card fill. The card fill is the binding constraint, so re-measure before darkening any dark surface.

tokens.name: tg-bg-dark
tokens.usage: The dark page floor. Resolves tg-bg in dark mode, and is the permanent footer fill in both themes.

tokens.name: tg-text-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Primary text on every dark ground. Resolves tg-fg in dark mode and tg-cta-bg on the inverted primary button.

tokens.name: tg-border-dark
tokens.usage: Dark-mode hairline. Resolves tg-border in dark mode and inside the always-dark ink band and footer.

tokens.name: tg-accent-blue
tokens.usage: Wayfinding for the Smart Operations line. Dots, stripe segments, pull-quote borders, tag borders. Never a button fill, never body text.

tokens.name: tg-accent-violet
tokens.usage: Wayfinding for the AI Voice Agents line. Same rules as tg-accent-blue.

tokens.name: tg-accent-amber
tokens.usage: Wayfinding for the Business Systems line. Same rules as tg-accent-blue. It measures 2.00:1 on white, so it is never text - use tg-accent-amber-text.

tokens.name: tg-accent-teal
tokens.usage: Wayfinding for the Custom Web Apps line. Same rules as tg-accent-blue.

tokens.name: tg-accent-blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue as small bold text on a light ground. 9.57:1 on tg-canvas.

tokens.name: tg-accent-violet-text
tokens.usage: Violet as small bold text on a light ground. 9.19:1 on tg-canvas.

tokens.name: tg-accent-amber-text
tokens.usage: Amber as small bold text on a light ground. 5.92:1 on tg-canvas.

tokens.name: tg-accent-teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal as small bold text on a light ground. 6.44:1 on tg-canvas.

tokens.name: tg-accent-blue-on-bg
tokens.usage: Blue accent text, theme-resolved. Tag labels on the Smart Operations line. 9.57:1 light, 5.05:1 on tg-bg-dark.

tokens.name: tg-accent-violet-on-bg
tokens.usage: Violet accent text, theme-resolved. 9.19:1 light, 5.17:1 on tg-bg-dark.

tokens.name: tg-accent-amber-on-bg
tokens.usage: Amber accent text, theme-resolved. The plain accent passes on tg-bg-dark, so dark mode needs no separate value.

tokens.name: tg-accent-teal-on-bg
tokens.usage: Teal accent text, theme-resolved. The plain accent passes on tg-bg-dark.

tokens.name: tg-success
tokens.usage: The 6px dot on a lead-capture success outcome. Dot only - the label beside it is tg-fg, so meaning never rests on hue alone.

tokens.name: tg-warning
tokens.usage: Reserved warning signal. Dot or icon only, always paired with a word.

tokens.name: tg-error
tokens.usage: The 6px dot on a lead-capture error outcome. Dot only, always paired with the word OutcomeBlock prints beside it.

shadow.note: Elevation is flat everywhere except the homepage fold's four build cards, which carry these two through .tg-lift. Every other surface is hairline-only and lifts from position, not shadow. Do not widen the exception.

tokens.name: tg-elevate
tokens.usage: Resting elevation on the fold's build cards. Two layers: a 1px contact shadow that keeps the edge crisp against the hairline, and a wide diffuse layer that does the lifting.

tokens.name: tg-elevate-hover
tokens.usage: The same cards on hover and focus-visible, paired with translate 0 -3px. Dark mode uses pure black at a much higher alpha, because a shadow tuned for white is invisible on #101010.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per route, the page's first headline. Ships as clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem): 40px at phone width, 72px from 1200px up. The ceiling is governed by a constraint, not the number - the headline must wrap to at most 3 lines on desktop with the CTA row still inside the first viewport.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section headings and the pull quote. Ships as clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem): 32px to 56px. The pull quote runs it at weight 600.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: The item-level heading step. A section head owns display; the things listed under it own subhead. Ships as clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem): 24px to 36px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and row titles: project-card, case-study-row, the proof claim. Ships as clamp(1.375rem, 2vw, 1.75rem): 22px to 28px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The body default, set on body itself. tg-fg on tg-bg, or tg-secondary for supporting copy.

styles.name: body-lead
styles.usage: A short emphasised line at body size - list leads and inline labels.

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: Card descriptions, the status line, footer links. Usually tg-secondary.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label on the site. The line height must ride ON the font-size declaration - a separate leading class is dropped by tailwind-merge and the button renders 8.7px too tall.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: The closing-CTA button only, the site's one documented size exception.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The compact status line on the fold's build cards, and fine print.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The uppercase label above a section head, and the solution tag. Ships as the .tg-eyebrow class; call sites still set colour and margin themselves.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Geist Mono appears in exactly two places: the whole StatusLine, and the concierge's inline code span. Numerals are tabular so the timestamp does not jitter.

spacing.note: Base unit 4px; the scale is 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64 96 128. The three density tokens declare intent and resolve per width - the printed value is the mobile-first base and the usage note gives all three steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Dot-to-label gap in the status line; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The grid gap on .tg-grid, and the card padding floor.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop container padding; form card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The row gap between stacked halves of a split.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Container padding from 1024px up.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Large block separation inside a long section.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Desktop section rhythm. Deliberately NOT a custom property in the code - content sections carry it at the call site. Recorded here as the measured value.

tokens.name: section-mobile
tokens.usage: Section rhythm at 767px and below. Same note as space-32: no custom property to look up.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width, centred, with container-pad inside it.

tokens.name: container-pad
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside the container. Drops to 24px below 768px.

tokens.name: pad-container
tokens.usage: Padding inside a full-bleed panel. 24px to 767, 32px from 768, 64px from 1024.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card in a multi-column grid. 24px to 767, 24px from 768 (identical on purpose - a card gains no width there, the grid gains tracks), 32px from 1024.

tokens.name: gap-group
tokens.usage: Between grouped elements inside one component. 28px to 767, 40px from 768, 56px from 1024.

tokens.name: tap-floor
tokens.usage: The minimum tap target, reached by a ::before overlay and never by resizing the control. Two 44px targets less than 44px apart overlap, so check every adjacency you create.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs, selects and textareas on the contact form.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The solution tag pill.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Every button, and the concierge launcher.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: project-card, case-study-row, the FAQ rows, the concierge panel.

tokens.name: radius-container
tokens.usage: LiveFrame and the hero media panel - the largest boxes on the page.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled button. Opacity only, plus cursor not-allowed.

tokens.name: tag-border
tokens.usage: The accent alpha in a solution tag's 1px border.

tokens.name: tag-fill
tokens.usage: The accent alpha in a solution tag's background. The card variant runs 0.14 so the tag still reads against tg-surface.
